decisions.reason: As a core GIS solution platform closely aligned with the firm's integrated enterprise geospatial strategy, it is more likely to be retained than discontinued despite normal portfolio review.

Mobile field data capture fits the firm's customer base and end-to-end geospatial offering well, so it likely stays on the market although ongoing mobile maintenance creates some discontinuation risk.

The search extension was still actively versioned in 2019 and supports the firm's web-map ecosystem, but as a narrower add-on it faces a higher chance of being folded into other products or retired than the larger core offerings.
